C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as an improper fraction (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as a fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to convert fractions to the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and the work only subtracts numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator (including the same-denominator case).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts equal fractions or produces 0 or a whole number result from fraction subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only performing conversions to common denominators without carrying out the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or rewriting as an integer or mixed number when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 21/12 → 7/4)
A step states the result is already in lowest terms or rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number/integer
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form conversion
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator
A step scales numerators/denominators to express fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract fractions correctly
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers by subtracting numerators over a common denominator (including cases where denominators already match).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction after denominators are the same (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts two equal fractions to get 0
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting forms without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying the final fraction without doing the subtraction operation

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing to lowest terms and/or converting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor to lowest terms
A step identifies an equivalent whole number (e.g., 8/8 = 1) or states the result is already in lowest terms
A step optionally rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number (or notes the equivalence)
exclusion_criteria: Any step that only performs the subtraction but does not reduce/normalize the form
Any step that only finds a common denominator or converts mixed numbers prior to subtraction

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/chooses a common denominator (e.g., 12, 18, 24)
A step converts each fraction to an equivalent fraction with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without changing denominators between two fractions

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with compatible denominators (including subtracting whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts when denominators are already the same (e.g., (6−4)/7)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
exclusion_criteria: Only performing conversions to common denominators without carrying out the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or rewriting as an integer or mixed number when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 21/12 → 7/4)
A step states or verifies the result is already in lowest terms
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number or a fraction as an integer (e.g., 8/8 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form-checking
Only finding a common denominator or converting representations prior to subtraction
